Despite val_state 'fading' on the headline, the absolute-trend gate is the one leg with validated risk control, and leadership is broad enough across constituents to avoid a one-name blow-up. Lean overweight as a staying-power expression, not a momentum call — but cap, not chase, given fading value state and mixed Hurst.
